summary: Staff Data Engineer and data architect. I design the architecture of a Databricks platform used by thousands of people, from lakehouse and governance to cost: more than 50% lower platform cost and ~3x fewer incidents. Still hands-on, with a technical team of 15+ people across Brazil and Romania, and comfortable across classic machine learning and generative AI.

roles.title: Staff Data Engineer
roles.intro: A Databricks data platform used by thousands of people across the whole company, with a team of 15+ people (engineering, analytics and data science) across Brazil and Romania.
bullets: Set the architecture and ways of working for a team of 15+ people (10 as Tech Lead), with a wider scope across the whole platform.
Still hands-on in architecture, modeling and platform decisions. When the team needs it, I set priorities and unblock business decisions.
roles.tech: Databricks, Unity Catalog, Delta Lake, Apache Spark, dbt, SQL, Python, AWS, Terraform, GitHub Actions

roles.title: Data Engineer – Tech Lead
roles.intro: Led a team of 10 people (engineering, analytics and data science) on a Databricks platform of tens of TB.
bullets: Cut the data platform's cost by more than 50% with a FinOps effort (clusters, jobs, storage, governance policies), including cost forecasting models. Annual spend: six figures (USD).
Reduced incidents and rework by ~3x by rolling out CI/CD with trunk-based development.
Delivered decision-support dashboards, platform-wide observability and near-real-time business metrics monitoring (latency of a few minutes), and restructured Unity Catalog by domain (10+).
Defined the architectures and ways of working for almost the whole data team. Helped create the company's LTV and payback models.
roles.tech: Databricks, Unity Catalog, Delta Lake, Apache Spark, dbt, SQL, Python, AWS, Terraform, Streamlit, Metabase

roles.title: Data Engineer
bullets: Led the migration of the company's entire data infrastructure to Databricks: ~50 sources (Google Analytics 4, internal systems and third-party tools) in a single platform, with pipelines going from hours to minutes.

Built the company's dimensional model and data lake from scratch with Python, dbt and SQL. Every area still uses that architecture today. Also contributed to the regulatory process that allowed the company to operate legally in Brazil.
roles.tech: Python, dbt, SQL, Databricks, Google Analytics 4

roles.title: Data Team Lead
bullets: One of the first engineers on Clicksign's data team. Grew the group from 4 to ~20 people across data engineering, data analysis and data quality assurance, and built the processes that sustained that growth.
Led the data engineering, data analysis and data quality assurance teams and was directly responsible for the reliability of the data used in company decisions.
roles.tech: Amazon Redshift, dbt, Apache Airflow, dimensional modeling

roles.title: Data Architect
bullets: Architected practically every data structure the company had in that period, including 100+ Airflow pipelines (modeling and ingestion).
Led the implementation of dbt on Redshift, which brought quality control, governance, easier modeling, observability and simpler orchestration.
Built 10+ APIs for sending data to partners and third parties, and architected the data protection processes (in compliance with LGPD and aligned with GDPR) and the continuity of data delivery.
roles.tech: Apache Airflow, dbt, Amazon Redshift, dimensional modeling, data governance
